key_idea: Total walking distance is a sum over the 8 gaps between adjacent keys of how many consecutive-character transitions cross that gap, which gives a subset DP over which digits occupy the left prefix.
sketch: Count c[a][b] = number of adjacent pairs {a,b} in s. Build the layout left to right: dp[mask] = min cost with the digits in mask occupying the first |mask| keys; adding a digit pays cut(newmask) = sum of c[a][b] for a in mask, b outside, plus 1 if s[0] is not in the mask (the ant starts on the leftmost key and must first walk to s[0]). Answer is dp[full] + |s| for the typing seconds. 2^9*81 work after an O(|s|) count. Brute-forcing all 9! layouts also fits. Verified against a 9! brute force on random short strings.
